svg.title: Sappho: about 650 of some 10,000 lines (estimate)
svg.desc: A 100 by 100 grid of 10,000 dots, a modern estimate of all the lines Sappho wrote, with 650 dots inked at random positions for the lines that survive; Book I (1,320 verses, from the papyrus end-title) outlined in red; the older 9,000 estimate marked with a dashed line. Educational demos made to show an open-source tool. Not research.

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #a8432a; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: square
fill: none; stroke-dasharray: 6.4,3.2; stroke-dashoffset: 0; stroke: #3f6e8c; stroke-width: 1.6
